secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase secret (service_role) API key — Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API Keys for project nzayozxwyasvcroshddy. Every data page reads through the server-side service-role client, so without it the dashboard/scoreboard/trade log render error pages.

secrets.name: MARKET_DATA_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Polygon.io API key for whole-market daily bars. Without it the app falls back to free Alpaca IEX data, or fails scanning if no Alpaca keys are set either.

secrets.name: ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Alpaca paper (simulated) account key id — alpaca.markets dashboard. Enables the free IEX market-data fallback and simulated trading.

secrets.name: ALPACA_PAPER_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Alpaca paper account secret key (paired with ALPACA_PAPER_KEY_ID).

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Alpaca live (real money) account key id. Only needed if you want the app to place real orders.

secrets.name: ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Alpaca live account secret key (paired with ALPACA_LIVE_KEY_ID).
